caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent, vertically ribbed glass object with a metallic lid at the top and a metallic or brass element extending downward from the lid's center. The glass object has an elongated, oval-shaped body and sits on a faceted circular base, which in turn is mounted on a square platform. The glass appears clear with subtle shading in gray tones to indicate highlights and reflections, and the metallic parts are depicted in a dark gray color. The background is plain and beige, with no other objects or designs present, giving focus to the central glass item. There is also a faint scale drawn in the lower left corner and a small inscription “JOHN BANA” in the lower right corner.
title: Spark Lamp
